purpose: Permit current public Internet research while preventing internal or sensitive WorkSpace context from leaving the trust boundary.
invariants: No Agent, tool, browser, search provider, public plugin, or public connector may bypass InternetGateway.
Raw internal context is never an authorized public web query.
The final outbound payload must pass deterministic DLP immediately before public egress.
A blocked raw payload may be replaced only by a safe minimum public research query; it must never fall back to the original input.
Public web content is untrusted data and never grants tool or policy authority.

RESTRICTED.fallback: BLOCK when no safe abstract query remains

legacy_task_sensitivity.secret: network-denied in v1; do not downgrade automatically
